methodology.gate: ENTER only when modelled expected return >= 1.02x ticket cost and economics sample minimum is met.
methodology.sharing: Jackpot split risk uses a Poisson collision model under uniform other-ticket selection. This is deliberately conservative for anti-crowd lines.
methodology.anti_crowd: Deterministic heuristic penalizes birthday-heavy and simple patterned combinations. It changes expected sharing only, never draw probability; no sharing uplift is credited in the gate.
methodology.payouts: Lower-tier payout estimates are medians of positive exact archived per-winner payouts available before the target draw.
methodology.sales: Equivalent line volume is derived from historical Total Sales divided by the verified rule-era ticket cost, then forecast from prior jackpot observations with conservative clamps.
methodology.historical_test: Each historical entry decision uses the target jackpot but only earlier economics to estimate payout and sales behavior; result and target payout table are used only for settlement.
